name: vllm_allspark_w8a16_gemm
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_allspark_w8a16_gemm.py. AllSpark W8A16 GEMM: a (M,K) fp16 activation times an int8-quantized weight. The test first quantizes qweight=randint(0,255,(K,N),uint8) and scale=randn(1,N,fp16) and reorders them via _custom_ops.allspark_repack_weight; gen_inputs reproduces that exact recipe (b_qweight/b_scales come from the repack op, so their declared shapes are placeholders and the real tensors are produced at eval time). Scalars mirror the test: b_qzeros=None, group_size=-1, sm_count=108, sm_version=80, CUBLAS_M_THRESHOLD=16, has_zp=False, n32k16_reorder=True. Default PyTree comparison over the (M,N) fp16 output. Requires vLLM (and an sm_80-class GPU) at eval time.
